headline: US stocks set for lower open as tech-driven Nasdaq weakness and wage data focus weigh ahead of major energy and pharma earnings
raw_text:
- S&P 500 Futures (@ES) fall 0.97%, Nasdaq 100 Futures (@NQ) drop 2.13%, Dow Jones Futures (@YM) edge down 0.06%, and Russell 2000 Futures (@ER2) decline 0.44% pre-market
- Alphabet (GOOGL) trades lower after Bank of America and UBS cut price targets following weak Q3 search results, a miss on estimates, and heavy AI capex that pressured profitability and free cash flow, adding AI-related pressure on Nasdaq ($COMP)-linked names
- ExxonMobil (XOM), AbbVie (ABBV), Chevron (CVX), and Regeneron (REGN) are scheduled to report earnings before the bell, with revenue and EPS versus consensus in focus for opening moves
- The Q3 Employment Cost Index is due at 8:30 AM ET and will be scrutinized for wage-inflation signals and labor-cost pressures
- Asian equities weaken overnight with Japan’s Nikkei 225 (@NKD) down over 2%
- European equity indices trade modestly higher in the early session
- Oil futures (@CL) gain around 1–2% amid elevated geopolitical tensions
- Gold (@GC) prices decline in overnight trading as investors reassess haven demand
- No major individual US stock movers with clear fundamental catalysts have been flagged in authoritative reporting published after 4:00 AM ET
